text:
jamie: Evening handoff proposal — can we shift triage sync to 18:00 UTC M-F? Running into overlaps with APAC oncalls. Proposed agenda: quick status, incident deep-dive, rollouts/blockers. Thoughts?

alex: +1 to 18:00 UTC. Also suggest requiring SRE + incident lead for any sev2+ discussion. 

tanya: Can we make Tuesdays a longer deep-dive (30m) for ongoing incidents? other days keep 20m.

lee: Happy either way. Important: rotation owner should present any open incidents summary and current mitigation steps.

sarah: +1 on mandatory incident lead for sev2. Also can someone add escalation contact list to the agenda?

jamie: Good point — draft agenda below. If no objections I'll update the calendar invite and set attendees.

```agenda
18:00 - quick status (5m) - rotation owner
18:05 - open incidents triage (12m) - incident owners
18:17 - escalations & action owners (5m)
18:22 - rollouts / canaries / scheduled deploys (3m)
18:25 - blockers / follow-ups (5m)
``` 

jamie: Proposed escalation attendance rule: sev1 -> all oncall + eng leads, sev2 -> oncall + incident lead + SRE, sev3 -> rotation owner only unless requested. 

alex: Agree. Also let's keep a persistent doc with incident links and follow-ups. I'll create a template in /docs/oncall/triage-template.md and add to invite.

oncall-bot: Calendar invite created for Daily Triage (Mon-Fri 18:00 UTC). Organizer: jamie. Attendees: jamie, alex, tanya, lee, sarah.

tanya: Small ask — can we alternate who runs the deep-dive Tue/Thu to avoid same ppl presenting?

jamie: Sure. I'll create a 2-week rotation in the calendar and add rotation owner assignment section to the doc. Action items:
- jamie: update invite + rotation (due today)
- alex: create triage template doc (due EOD)
- lee: add escalation contact list to doc (due tomorrow)
- tanya: volunteer to run first Tue deep-dive

sarah: Thanks — LGTM. :thumbsup:

jamie: If no objections by EOD I'll lock the schedule. Thanks everyone.
